sources.title: Play! Pokémon Competitive Pokémon Rules and Formats
sources.verification: The official index provides maintained entry points for rulebooks, tournament rules, legality notices and errata.
sources.supportsZh: 用于持续核验当前规则包，索引页本身不被解释为某个历史单卡的完整时序裁定。

retrievalLimitations: No PTCG Live behavior, Chinese translation, image or community source is used as rule authority.
No card family or name is automatically inferred to have a Rule Box.
Every real card remains unavailable until its complete official text, timing and legality are audited.
implementationLimits: Supports an explicit, audited RULE_BOX marker on a Pokémon card definition, both for in-play conditions and for reviewed private-zone search filters.
Does not implement default family inference, non-Pokémon Rule Boxes, card-specific suppression, format bans or any real card binding.
Batch card data must supply traceable Rule Box metadata before a condition or search filter may affect a playable real card.
